subject: general
question: What is the theme of World Cancer Day 2026, observed globally to raise awareness and mobilise action against cancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United by Unique.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **World Cancer Day 2026 is observed with the theme “United by Unique”, focusing on people-centred cancer care and individual experiences.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The theme “United by Unique” highlights that every cancer journey is different and deserves personalised care.**
 
• It emphasises placing people and their stories at the centre of cancer care systems.
 
• The theme is part of a three-year campaign cycle run by the UICC.
 
• It promotes equity, dignity and compassion in cancer prevention and treatment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• World Cancer Day__

 __
 
• Observed annually on 4 February.
 
• Led by the Union for International Cancer Control.
 
• Aims to raise awareness, encourage prevention and improve access to cancer care.
 
 
 
• Union for International Cancer Control__
 __
 
• Founded in 1933.
 
• A global organisation uniting cancer control organisations worldwide.
 
• Runs World Cancer Day campaigns in three-year thematic cycles.
 
 
 
• Theme Cycle__
 
 
• Allows deeper engagement with one core idea over multiple years.
 
• Helps achieve sustained global impact in cancer awareness and advocacy.
